articles.title: Inspired by Drishyam, Wife Plots Husband’s Murder with Lover in Gurugram
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A chilling murder case has surfaced from Gurugram, Haryana, involving Vikram, a contractor originally from Nawada, Bihar, who was allegedly kidnapped, murdered, and buried by his wife Soni Devi and her lover Ravindra, with the help of three others. The shocking twist?

body.html:
A chilling murder case has surfaced from Gurugram, Haryana, involving Vikram, a contractor originally from Nawada, Bihar, who was allegedly kidnapped, murdered, and buried by his wife Soni Devi and her lover Ravindra, with the help of three others.

The shocking twist? The couple learned to cover up the crime by watching the film Drishyam and episodes of Crime Patrol.

🔴 Daughter’s Revelation Triggered the Plot
According to police, Vikram’s minor daughter had caught her mother and Ravindra watching obscene videos together, and she informed her father. This exposed their affair, and fearing disgrace and a broken home, Soni and Ravindra decided to eliminate Vikram.

📱 Continuous Phone Contact, Premeditated Crime
Police found that Soni and Ravindra were in constant mobile contact from the time of the kidnapping to the murder and burial. Ravindra and his three friends — Manish (19), Fariyad (20), and one absconding accomplice — allegedly kidnapped Vikram on July 26, strangled him with a rope, and buried his body in a pit dug in advance by Ravindra’s uncle Santarpal.

On July 28, Soni filed a missing person report. Later, to divert suspicion, she accused Ravindra of rape and claimed he was threatening to release explicit videos — a ploy that eventually collapsed under police interrogation.

🧩 Investigation Details:
● The murder plan was inspired by Drishyam and Crime Patrol.
● The pit was dug in advance by Santarpal, who works as a cattle caretaker.
● The body was buried quickly to avoid foul smell or discovery.
● Soni stayed in touch with Ravindra throughout the crime.
● Police used call data records and interrogations to piece together the crime.

Arrested So Far:
● Soni Devi (Wife)
● Ravindra (Lover)
● Manish (Momos cart vendor)
● Fariyad (Bike repairman)
● Santarpal (Ravindra’s uncle who dug the pit)
● One accused is still absconding. Raids are ongoing.

Police released a photo of the five accused in custody, including the wife and her boyfriend, shocking the local community.

👇 What's your take?
How far can people go to protect a lie?
Should movies and crime shows bear any responsibility for such inspiration?

body.html:
Hapur (Uttar Pradesh) – A major tragedy was narrowly avoided in Garhmukteshwar area of Hapur district after a dilapidated government school building suddenly collapsed with a loud crash. The building had been closed for years due to its poor condition.

articles.title: Uttarakhand: 4 Dead, Dozens Feared Missing After Flash Floods Ravage Dharali Village in Uttarkashi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Dehradun — At least four people have died and many are feared missing after a cloudburst triggered a devastating flash flood in the upper catchment of the Kheer Ganga river, wreaking havoc in Dharali village, Uttarkashi district, on Tuesday.

body.html:
Dehradun — At least four people have died and many are feared missing after a cloudburst triggered a devastating flash flood in the upper catchment of the Kheer Ganga river, wreaking havoc in Dharali village, Uttarkashi district, on Tuesday.

Uttarkashi District Magistrate Prashant Arya confirmed the fatalities, adding that rescue operations are underway. “A massive wave of flash flood hit the area. We’re assessing the damage to life and property,” he said.

Personnel from the Army, NDRF, SDRF, and ITBP have been deployed. Rescue teams from Harsil and Bhatwari are searching for possible survivors. Authorities fear that 10–12 labourers may be trapped under debris, and several hotels and homestays have been washed away.

Union Home Minister Amit Shah spoke with Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, directing central agencies to expedite relief efforts.

Dramatic visuals showed floodwaters tearing through homes, shops, and roads, leaving behind destruction and panic. In Barkot tehsil’s Banala Patti, 18 goats were swept away in the Kud Gadhera stream.

The Meteorological Department has warned of heavy rainfall until August 10, especially in hilly regions.

articles.title: UP Shocker: 21-Yr-Old Jailed for 7 Months After Being Caught With Married Woman
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a bizarre and controversial case from Uttar Pradesh, a 21-year-old man spent seven months in jail after a rape case was filed against him — despite being caught red-handed in a consensual sexual encounter with a 31-year-old married woman.

body.html:
In a bizarre and controversial case from Uttar Pradesh, a 21-year-old man spent seven months in jail after a rape case was filed against him — despite being caught red-handed in a consensual sexual encounter with a 31-year-old married woman.

According to reports, the woman invited her young lover, who is also her husband’s cousin, to her home at night, while her husband and mother-in-law slept in another room. The duo was caught in the act, following which the husband beat up his cousin.

The woman later reconciled with her husband, and then filed a rape case against the youth. Based solely on her statement, the man was arrested and remained behind bars for seven months before the case began to unravel.

The incident has reignited the debate over misuse of rape laws and the lack of gender neutrality in India’s legal framework for sexual offences.

articles.title: Gujarat: CCTV Captures Shocking Collision Between Cyclist and Auto-Rickshaw in Patan
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic road accident was caught on CCTV in Gujarat’s Patan district on Saturday, August 2, around 1:40 PM. The footage shows a cyclist suddenly taking a U-turn from behind a tractor-trolley, directly into the path of a speeding auto-rickshaw approaching from the opposite direction.

body.html:
A dramatic road accident was caught on CCTV in Gujarat’s Patan district on Saturday, August 2, around 1:40 PM. The footage shows a cyclist suddenly taking a U-turn from behind a tractor-trolley, directly into the path of a speeding auto-rickshaw approaching from the opposite direction.

The rickshaw collided with the bicycle, overturned violently, and threw the driver and passengers onto the road. The cyclist also fell and sustained minor injuries. Thankfully, no major casualties were reported.

Bystanders rushed to the scene and assisted the injured, helping bring the situation under control quickly.

articles.title: Bihar Horror: Speeding Thar Mows Down Four in Rohtas, Woman Killed, Three Seriously Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A horrifying road accident took place near Jamua petrol pump in Rohtas district’s Karakat police station area on Sunday evening, where a speeding and uncontrolled Thar jeep crushed four people standing roadside. The CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral, triggering widespread anger.

body.html:
A horrifying road accident took place near Jamua petrol pump in Rohtas district’s Karakat police station area on Sunday evening, where a speeding and uncontrolled Thar jeep crushed four people standing roadside. The CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral, triggering widespread anger.

The deceased has been identified as Indu Devi (40), wife of Hridayanand Pandit, a resident of Jamua village. The injured include an 8-year-old child Pawan, along with Salamuddin Ansari (30) and Salim Ansari (32) — all seriously hurt and currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital in Bikramganj.

The CCTV video clearly shows a woman walking with items in hand and three people sitting near a parked scooter and bicycle. Suddenly, a Thar jeep crashes at high speed, hitting the woman first, then ramming into the others and plunging into a ditch after breaking the bridge railing.

Villagers caught the Thar driver and two passengers, allegedly in an intoxicated state, and beat them up before handing them over to police. In protest, angry locals blocked the Bikramganj–Dehri road for hours, demanding strict action.

Police have seized the vehicle and begun an investigation. Authorities say CCTV evidence and eyewitness accounts will be crucial in prosecuting the culprits.
